description: Steady-state simulation of a natural gas sweetening unit using DEA solvent in Aspen HYSYS V14. Models full absorption-regeneration loop. >99.9% H₂S removal. Complete stream tables, column profiles, and energy analysis included.

Steady-state simulation of an Atmospheric Crude Distillation Unit (CDU) processing Arabian Light crude using Aspen HYSYS V14. Includes pump-around circuit design and a heat integration study achieving a 53.6% reduction in furnace duty through Pinch Analysis principles.
